_comment: Topic-specific categories. Keyword patterns drive the no-key classifier (first 3 matches, in order).

categories.name: Recovery agents & debt collection
categories.description: Harassing recovery agents and debt collectors, threats, calls to family and contacts.

categories.name: Illegal loan apps & scams
categories.description: Fake instant-loan apps, illegal lenders, morphed photos, data misuse.
keywords: loan app|instant loan|fake loan|illegal (lender|loan)|loan scam|morphed|unregistered lender|predatory

categories.name: Loan rejected or can't qualify
categories.description: Applications denied, unclear eligibility, income and paperwork hurdles.

categories.name: Credit score & report problems
categories.description: Low or wrong scores, report errors, scores dropping, hard to rebuild.

categories.name: High interest, EMIs & rate hikes
categories.description: High interest/APR, EMI burden, floating-rate hikes, tenure extensions.
keywords: interest rate|\bemi\b|\bapr\b|rate (hike|increase|rise)|variable rate|floating rate|repo rate|monthly payment|tenure

categories.name: Processing, prepayment & hidden fees
categories.description: Processing fees, foreclosure/prepayment penalties, forced insurance, late fees.

categories.name: Buy-now-pay-later traps
categories.description: BNPL late fees, overspending, collections, credit-score hits.

categories.name: Student loan repayment
categories.description: Servicer problems, repayment plans, forgiveness, interest growth.

categories.name: Mortgage & home-loan process
categories.description: Slow sanction or disbursal, valuations, underwriting, closing delays.

categories.name: Refinancing & balance transfer
categories.description: Hard or costly to refinance, switch lenders or consolidate.

categories.name: Debt stress & missed payments
categories.description: Can't keep up with payments, defaults, settlements, insolvency.

categories.name: Other
categories.description: Clear customer pain point that does not fit any category above.
